summary: Iteration 3 regression after the Netlify/undefined-API bugfix. Backend: 6/6 pytest passing (added /api/health check and JSON-error-shape check for login). Frontend: public site (hero, 3 services, quote form), quote submission, admin login with correct creds -> dashboard + tab navigation (quotes: 7 records), wrong creds -> backend message 'E-mail ou senha inválidos', simulated non-JSON (HTML 404) login response -> 'Resposta inválida do servidor...' (no 'Unexpected token <' crash), simulated network failure -> 'Não foi possível conectar ao backend...'. /admin deep link renders login form. netlify.toml + public/_redirects present and correctly configured (publish resolves to frontend/build, SPA fallback 200).
critical_code_review_comments: The !API guard only exists in Admin.doLogin. Public component fetches (`${API}/api/public`, /api/leads/click, /api/quotes) still build 'undefined/api/...' and fail silently via .catch(()=>{}) when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is missing — consider showing a visible banner so a misconfigured Netlify build is obvious on the public site too (non-blocking).

Routing is state-based (window.location.pathname read once, no history.pushState). Navigating to /admin from the site does not change the URL, so browser back/refresh loses the admin view. Minor UX, not part of this bugfix.
App.js is a single dense file with very long lines; splitting Public/Admin into modules would improve maintainability.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ quote via API test and one 'TEST_QA Iter3' quote via UI form submission (leftover records in quotes collection).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend untouched since iteration 2; tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_dinho_api.py (now 6 tests incl. health + login-error JSON shape). Error-path login tests are done via Playwright page.route interception (fulfill HTML 404 / abort). Note: page.goto with an active route interception timed out on 'load'; use page.reload(wait_until='domcontentloaded') instead.
rca_of_the_issue: Original 404 /undefined/api/auth/login came from a missing REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL at Netlify build time. Fixes verified: explicit API-undefined guard, text()-then-JSON.parse with a friendly fallback message, and SPA redirects. All error paths render inside [data-testid=login-error] without crashing.
